<div class="card-body">
'''Anakin's Lightsaber''' is a [[Light]] [[Weapon]] from [[Reflections III: A Collector's Bounty|Reflections III: A Collector's Bounty]].

<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">アナキンのライトセーバー</span><ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">能力値＞3のスカイウォーカーにフォースを消費せずに配備する。キャラクターがいる場所のフォース消耗に＋1。フォースを消費せずに起動する。キャラクターを目標とする。運命数を2枚引く。運命数の合計＞能力値なら、キャラクターに命中し、目標は没収値＝0となる。</span><ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">アナキン・スカイウォーカーが作ったライトセーバー。ルークに手渡すべく、オビ＝ワンが保管していた。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Anakin's Lightsaber.

'''Card text:''' Deploy without spending Force on a Skywalker with ability > 3. Add 1 to Force drains at the location where the character is. Use without spending Force. Target a character. Draw two destiny. If total destiny > ability, the character is hit and the target's forfeit becomes 0.

'''Lore:''' A lightsaber made by Anakin Skywalker. Obi-Wan kept it in order to hand it over to Luke.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese states the Force-drain bonus and the free weapon use in separate sentences. The foil writes オビ＝ワン where the Hoth Japanese printing writes オビーワン.
<h2>Notes</h2>
'''Anakin's Lightsaber (Japanese Reflections III Foil)''' is a Japanese-language foil printing of [[Anakin's Lightsaber|Anakin's Lightsaber]]. [[Decipher]] released it in [[Reflections III: A Collector's Bounty]] in October 2001. The ordinary Japanese expansion printing is [[Anakin's Lightsaber (Japanese)]]. Complete Card List v4 lists checklist R98 at rarity SR. Collector R-numbers are checklist references, not GEMP blueprint IDs.<ref name="checklist">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/swccgcardlist4.0.pdf Star Wars Customizable Card Game Complete Card List v4.0], p. 32, Reflections III foil cards, R98. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009184033/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/swccgcardlist4.0.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], p. 22. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Anakins-Lightsaber-Reflections-III-Foil-SWCA.jpg|Original Japanese foil face]]. Photograph by Duncan Jenkins.</ref>
